clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Ghoul Fang is gathered from the undead for Madame Eva’s protective talismans. The fangs are essential to her work in Darkshire, where travelers face the forest’s encroaching darkness.

Ravenous undead haunt Duskwood’s shadowed woods and graves. Flesh Eaters lurk near the burial grounds, while Rotted Ones roam among the trees. Taking a fang from these creatures is grim work, and proof of survival against the dead threatening Darkshire’s borders.

Madame Eva, Darkshire’s fortune teller and mystic, sees terrible omens around travelers who cross Duskwood. She combines ghoul fangs with skeletal fingers and arachnid venom to enchant the Totem of Infliction. The charm turns the forest’s dark forces against violent assault, protecting the one who bears it.
